purpose: A right-aligned metric cell whose delta shows how the value moved, up, down or unchanged, with an arrow, a colour and a hidden word.

notFor.case: Not for standalone use outside a table row.
A trend over time drawn as a line.
A plain number with no change.

Default.visual: Value in Content/primary (Type/body-sm); the trend icon (Size/icon-sm) and delta label (Type/helper) in the Trend's ink.

Disabled.visual: Value, trend icon and delta label in Content/disabled.

Trend=up.visual: Trend icon and delta label in Status/success/content.

Trend=down.visual: Trend icon and delta label in Status/critical/content.

Trend=neutral.visual: Trend icon and delta label in Content/secondary.

notes: A visually hidden word (up, down, unchanged) precedes the delta, so the direction is not colour alone.

openQuestions: Motion: State Default · Disabled has no motion decision in the contract (finding MOT-002 TableTrendCell). Confirm the cell needs none.
Up is always success and down always critical. What about metrics where down is good, such as cost or errors?
